tasks.task: Summarize a 12-page claims file into a 1-paragraph adjuster brief
tasks.criteria: Covers claimant name, incident date, requested amount, and any red flags, in under 150 words

tasks.task: Decide if a water-damage claim needs a special investigations unit referral
tasks.criteria: Flags claims over $25k, or with prior claims in the last 12 months, and cites the trigger

tasks.task: Draft a denial letter citing the specific policy exclusion
tasks.criteria: Cites the exact clause number and explains the reason in plain language, no legal jargon

tasks.task: Calculate the depreciated value of a damaged roof from its age and replacement cost
tasks.criteria: Applies the correct depreciation schedule and shows the formula used

tasks.task: Flag duplicate claims submitted under different claim numbers
tasks.criteria: Matches on policyholder, date, and loss description with no false positives

tasks.task: Extract all named parties and their roles from a subrogation demand letter
tasks.criteria: Lists every party with the correct role: claimant, defendant, insurer, or attorney

tasks.task: Explain in 3 bullets why a claim was paid at actual cash value instead of replacement cost
tasks.criteria: References the specific policy section and the depreciation reasoning

tasks.task: Check a repair estimate for line items outside a given price guide range
tasks.criteria: Lists every line item more than 15% outside the guide price, with the guide price shown

tasks.task: Draft a follow-up email requesting missing documentation from a claimant
tasks.criteria: Lists exactly which documents are missing and gives a clear deadline

tasks.task: Summarize the key terms of a multi-page subrogation agreement in 5 bullets
tasks.criteria: Includes the recovery amount, split percentage, and effective date
